correctness.rationale: The direct integral-kernel computation is checked against five independent scalar quadratures in each of four minimal systems; the proof gives K=RUPU*R-UPU*. Stability and controllability make P positive, observability gives U injective, and coprimeness of the stable annihilator p(D) and reflected p(-D) forces disjoint ranges. Congruence and parity decomposition give rank 2d, inertia (d,d), and the exact finite positive-matrix spectral law. Finite numerical checks support, but do not replace, the proof.

This is an exact structural bridge between finite system order, Hilbert-space operator rank and quantitative spectral data, not an isolated arithmetic example or a small numerical increment.
